# LakeShore Legends Basketball

> LakeShore Legends Basketball is a training-first youth basketball program based in Park Ridge, Illinois, led by owner and head trainer Coach Gio Paganis. It offers private 1-on-1 and small group basketball skills training, camps, and player development in the Park Ridge and Mundelein, IL areas (Chicago north and northwest suburbs).

## Key facts
- Founder / head trainer: Gio Paganis ("Coach Gio") — from Park Ridge, IL; Purdue M.S.; over a decade coaching and training athletes; head Junior Varsity basketball coach at Mundelein High School; director of the Jr. Mustangs Feeder Basketball program; shooting specialist.
- Philosophy: training first — skill mastery, basketball IQ, and long-term development over playing excessive games.
- Program results: 24 travel teams coached; 250+ athletes trained; 25+ college recruitment offers; 7+ college basketball commitments.
- Locations: Park Ridge, IL and Mundelein, IL areas. The exact gym or court is arranged with Coach Gio after booking.
- Ages: all ages and skill levels for private/small group training; camps typically rising 3rd–8th grade.

## Training and prices (60-minute sessions, booked and paid online)
- Private 1-on-1 Basketball Training: $79.99 per session
- 2-on-1 Small Group Basketball Training: $59.99 per athlete
- 3-on-1 Small Group Basketball Training: $49.99 per athlete
- 4+ Player Small Group Basketball Training: $39.99 per athlete

## Booking
- Book online: https://www.lakeshorelegendsbasketball.com/training.html — choose an open date and time, then pay securely with Stripe. The time is held for 10 minutes during checkout; a confirmation email follows payment.
- Book at least 24 hours in advance. No suitable time? Use "Request Training" on the same page.
- Cancellation: more than 48 hours ahead — 100% refund; within 48 hours — 50% retainer.

## Frequently asked questions
### Where are LakeShore Legends training sessions held?
Sessions are held in the Park Ridge, IL and Mundelein, IL areas. After you book, reach out to Coach Gio to set the exact gym or court.

### How do I book a basketball training session?
Pick an open date and time on the Training page, choose 1-on-1 or small group training, and pay securely with Stripe. Your time is held for 10 minutes while you pay, and you receive a confirmation email once payment goes through.

### How much does private basketball training cost?
A 60-minute private 1-on-1 session is $79.99. Small group sessions are priced per athlete: $59.99 each for 2-on-1, $49.99 each for 3-on-1, and $39.99 each for groups of 4 or more.

### How does payment work for small group sessions?
Each family pays for its own athlete. The parent who books pays for their athlete and receives a payment link to share with the other families in the group.

### What is the cancellation policy?
Cancellations made more than 48 hours in advance receive a 100% refund. Cancellations made within 48 hours of a session are subject to a 50% retainer.

### How far in advance do I need to book?
Sessions must be booked at least 24 hours ahead. If you do not see a time that works, use Request Training and Coach Gio will try to make it work.

### Who runs the training?
Training is led by Coach Gio Paganis, owner of LakeShore Legends Basketball. He is from Park Ridge, Illinois, holds a Purdue M.S., and has coached and trained athletes for over a decade. He is the head Junior Varsity coach at Mundelein High School and a shooting specialist.

### What ages and skill levels do you train?
Private and small group training is open to all ages and skill levels. Camps are grouped by grade, typically rising 3rd through 8th grade.
